amenitiesDescription:
Three swimming pools — a lap pool, a family pool, and a bayside pool — plus a Jacuzzi, a kids' splash-pad, and a dedicated kids' room. An entire floor is devoted to health and fitness, curated by the Aman group, with yoga and personal-training areas, his-and-hers dressing rooms, saunas, steam rooms, and indoor and outdoor massage treatment rooms.

Additional amenities include a movie theater, a catering kitchen and private dining room, indoor and outdoor owners' lounges, exclusive access to the Grand Bay Club in Key Biscayne, white-glove residential services, baywalk access, and private air-conditioned storage areas.

investmentThesis: The last available bayfront development site in South Brickell — a supply position that will not be replicated, with 150 feet of direct water frontage. AS+GG, the firm behind the Burj Khalifa and Central Park Tower, provides architectural credibility at the highest global tier. Vladislav Doronin's OKO Group (also behind Aman Miami Beach and Aman New York) brings a track record in ultra-luxury delivery. UNA is now move-in ready with immediate occupancy available, eliminating construction risk for buyers — and represents the first waterfront development in this South Brickell enclave in over two decades. The bayfront corridor provides direct access to Coconut Grove, Downtown Miami, and Key Biscayne.
name: UNA Residences

residenceContent: A 47-story waterfront tower whose curved glass silhouette is drawn directly from the Italian Riva yacht. Architecture and interiors by AS+GG, with lush gardens by Enzo Enea. 135 luxury residences range from two to five bedrooms and 1,102 to 4,735 square feet, plus two tri-level penthouses of 7,084 and 7,089 interior square feet with 2,871 square feet of terrace and rooftop. Each home offers private elevators with direct entry, expansive ~10-foot-wide terraces with lift-and-glide floor-to-ceiling doors and glass balcony railings, ceiling heights of at least 10'8", chef's kitchens with Gaggenau ovens, electric induction cooktops, microwaves, dishwashers, and refrigerators/freezers, primary suites with separate his-and-hers closets and bathrooms, and utility rooms with full-sized washers and dryers. Upper-floor flow-through residences capture east-to-west ocean and city exposures. The penthouses each include two private pools, a summer kitchen, sauna and steam room, and ceilings from 11'7" to 12'4". Three levels of underground parking. High-efficiency, noise-reducing floor-to-ceiling exterior glass throughout.
